This implies that Dinoprostone may influence Slco1c1 through its interaction with Slco4a1, which is critical for the transport activity of Slco1c1. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible regulatory mechanism where Dinoprostone could modulate Slco1c1 function, potentially affecting thyroid hormone transport. The evidence supports a functional relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
